mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 months signals a shift toward accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates and increasing present-value weights on future cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a risk-off reaction in equity markets, compressing discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) exceeding 10,000 over 3 months indicates weakening labor market demand, which reduces equity discount rates and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in weakening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) below 8,000 for 3 months signals strengthening labor demand, which increases discount rates and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in retail sales (GDPC1) exceeding 2% for 3 consecutive months indicates robust consumer demand, which compresses discount rates and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in demand expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 1% for 3 consecutive months indicates weakening supply capacity, which reduces discount rates and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in weakening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% for 3 months signals a strong labor market, which increases discount rates and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in strong labor market periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
